de.meta_description: Wandern, Biken, Golf, Kultur und Umgebung rund um Hotel Weinberg in St. Pauls/Eppan, Drei-Burgen-Wanderung, Golfclub Eppan, Kalterer See, Montiggler Seen und mehr.
de.hero_heading:
Wandern, Biken, Genießen:
direkt vor der Tür
de.hero_text: Burgen, Seen und Weinberge liegen direkt vor der Tür, mitten in Südtirols schönster Ferienregion.
de.story_lede: Scrollt weiter durch Wandern, Bike, Golf, Kultur und die Umgebung, am Ende findet ihr alle Tipps als Karteikarten, filterbar nach Art und Zeitaufwand.

chapters.heading: Burgen, Wälder und Blütentäler
chapters.lede: Von der Drei-Burgen-Wanderung über Hocheppan, Boymont und Korb bis zum blühenden Frühlingstal zwischen den Montiggler Seen und dem Kalterer See, die Wanderwege beginnen direkt vor der Haustür.
chapters.body: Auch die historische Mendel-Standseilbahn mit dem Gipfel des Roen, die Ruine Leuchtenburg über dem Kalterer See und der beschauliche Kreuzweg zur Gleifkirche mit Aussichtspunkt Kreuzstein sind in 10 bis 25 Fahrminuten erreichbar.

chapters.heading: Auf zwei Rädern durch die Weinberge
chapters.lede: Der Bahntrassenradweg Bozen–Eppan–Kaltern führt direkt an den Weinbergen des Hotels vorbei, flach, familientauglich und mit Weitblick auf die Dolomiten.
chapters.body: Wer weiter will, folgt dem Etschtal-Radweg bis nach Meran oder dreht die Mitterbergerrunde von Eppan über den Kalterer See und Auer zurück nach Bozen, fast durchgehend flach, entlang Obstwiesen und historischer Ansitze.

chapters.bg_alt: Golfclub Eppan Blue Monster von oben
chapters.heading: Abschlag mit Schlossblick
chapters.lede: Der Golfclub Eppan „Blue Monster" liegt nur wenige Fahrminuten entfernt, ein 9-Loch-Platz mit Seen und Bergblick, direkt daneben das Trainingscenter Schloss Freudenstein mit Kurzplatz, Driving Range und Putting Green.
chapters.body: Für längere Runden sind die 9-Loch-Anlage in Lana und der 18-Loch-Platz Dolomiti auf der Mendel in rund 30–45 Fahrminuten erreichbar.

chapters.heading: Drei Burgen, tausend Jahre Geschichte
chapters.lede: Schloss Hocheppan mit seiner romanischen Burgkapelle, Schloss Boymont und Schloss Korb prägen die Silhouette über den Weinbergen.
chapters.body: Wer weiterfährt, findet in Schloss Sigmundskron das Messner Mountain Museum Firmian: Bergsteigergeschichte mit Panoramablick auf Bozen. Und gleich nebenan, in St. Pauls, öffnet die Kellerei St. Pauls ihre Türen: zur Weinführung durch das Paulsnerfeld oder zur „Preclarus"-Führung durch den Sektbunker aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg.

chapters.heading: Seen zum Verweilen
chapters.lede: Die Montiggler Seen mit freiem Zugang und der Kalterer See mit seinen Badestränden liegen beide in rund 15–20 Fahrminuten, ideal für einen Nachmittag am Wasser.
chapters.body: Wer einen ganzen Tag investieren will, fährt über den Mendelpass oder durchs Etschtal an den Gardasee, Riva del Garda und Torbole mit Seepromenade, Windsurfern und der Bergbahn auf den Monte Baldo.

guide_cards.alt: Schloss Korb, Drei-Burgen-Wanderung
guide_cards.title: Drei-Burgen-Wanderung
guide_cards.desc: Gemütliche Familientour über den Burgenweg Nr. 9 zu Schloss Hocheppan mit romanischer Burgkapelle, weiter zu Schloss Boymont und zurück über Schloss Korb.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: kostenlos · Burgkapelle ca. 3 € ca. 8 km · ca. 250 Hm

guide_cards.alt: Schloss Hocheppan mit Burgkapelle
guide_cards.title: Schloss Hocheppan & Burgkapelle
guide_cards.desc: Die besterhaltene Burg Südtirols mit der romanischen Burgkapelle und ihren Fresken aus dem 12. Jh., die Kapelle ist nur im Rahmen einer kunsthistorischen Führung zugänglich, unten in der Burgschenke gibt's Südtiroler Küche mit Panoramablick.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: ca. 10 Fahrmin. + kurzer Fußweg Führung ca. 30 Min., Besuch ca. 1–1,5 Std.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: Burgkapelle/Führung ca. 3 € Führungen 11:00–16:30, je nach Saison Do–Mo
guide_cards.hours: Saison ab 28. März bis November · Burgschenke tgl. 10–18 Uhr, Mi Ruhetag

guide_cards.alt: Schloss Boymont bei Eppan
guide_cards.title: Schloss Boymont
guide_cards.desc: 1977 restaurierte Burgruine mit gut erhaltenen Mauern und stimmungsvollem Innenhof, heute mit Jausenstation, ideal für eine Rast im Schatten der alten Gemäuer auf halber Strecke der Burgenwanderung.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: Eintritt Burgruine auf Anfrage Ostern–November, Di–So 10–18 Uhr

guide_cards.alt: Frühlingstal bei Eppan
guide_cards.title: Frühlingstal zum Kalterer See
guide_cards.desc: Leichte Wanderung entlang des Angelbachs durch blütenreiche Laub- und Mischwälder, zwischen Montiggler See und Kalterer See, im zeitigen Frühjahr ein Blütenmeer aus Märzenbechern.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: kostenlos ca. 10 km · flach

guide_cards.alt: Wanderer rasten am Ufer des Montiggler Sees im Herbst
guide_cards.place: Start: Schreckbichl oder Großer Montiggler See
guide_cards.title: Montiggler Wald mit Seen
guide_cards.desc: Schattige Waldwege durch den Montiggler Wald, vorbei am Großen und Kleinen Montiggler See, mit kurzem Abstecher zum Aussichtspunkt Wilder-Mann-Bühel, ruhig, flach und ganzjährig ein beliebtes Naherholungsgebiet.

guide_cards.alt: Radweg Überetsch, Eppan
guide_cards.title: Wein & Bike am Kalterer See
guide_cards.desc: Fast flacher Radweg auf ehemaliger Bahntrasse, führt direkt an den Weinbergen des Hotels vorbei bis zum Kalterer See, ideal auch mit Kindern.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: direkt ab Hotel ca. 1,5 Std. einfach
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: kostenlos · E-Bike-Verleih ab ca. 25 €/Tag ca. 18 km · flach

guide_cards.alt: Etschtal-Radweg Richtung Meran
guide_cards.title: Etschtal-Radweg nach Meran
guide_cards.desc: Entspannte, fast durchgehend flache Tour am Fluss entlang, vorbei an Obstwiesen, historischen Ansitzen und Schloss Sigmundskron bis nach Meran.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: ca. 10 Fahrmin. zum Etschtalradweg ca. 3–4 Std. einfach
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: kostenlos · Rückfahrt mit Zug möglich ca. 45 km · flach

guide_cards.alt: Trainingscenter Schloss Freudenstein
guide_cards.title: Trainingscenter Schloss Freudenstein
guide_cards.desc: 4-Loch-Kurzplatz, 240 m Driving Range mit 16 Abschlägen und großzügiges Putting Green, umgeben von Weinbergen, mit Bar und Golfsimulator für Schlechtwettertage.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: Greenfee ca. 20 € · Range-Tageskarte ca. 15 € ⛳ 4 Loch + Übungsanlage

guide_cards.alt: Golfclub Eppan Blue Monster
guide_cards.title: Golfclub Eppan „Blue Monster"
guide_cards.desc: 9-Loch-Platz (Par 35) von Golfarchitekt Thomas C. Himmel, 2015 eröffnet, benannt nach den zahlreichen Wasserhindernissen, umgeben von Apfelwiesen und mit 4-Sterne-Superior-Klassifizierung.
guide_cards.hours: Saisonal geöffnet · Golfschule & Simulator vor Ort

guide_cards.alt: Golfclub Lana Gutshof Brandis
guide_cards.title: Golfclub Lana „Gutshof Brandis"
guide_cards.desc: 9-Loch-Anlage (Par 35, 2.793 m) unterhalb der Burgruine Brandis bei Meran, gestaltet vom englischen Platzarchitekten Michael Pinner, malerische Lage mit Blick auf die Texelgruppe.

guide_cards.alt: Golfclub Dolomiti Sarnonico auf der Mendel
guide_cards.title: Golfclub Dolomiti (Sernonico/Mendel)
guide_cards.desc: 18-Loch-Platz auf 900 m Höhe, 1991 eröffnet, eine der anspruchsvollsten Anlagen der Alpen, umgeben von Wäldern, Obstwiesen und Bergdörfern jenseits des Mendelpasses.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: Greenfee auf Anfrage ⛳ 18 Loch + 4 Übungslöcher

guide_cards.alt: Kalterer See
guide_cards.title: Kalterer See
guide_cards.desc: Einer der wärmsten Badeseen der Alpen, umgeben von Weinbergen, vier Badeanlagen mit Liegewiese, Steg und Blick auf den Mendelkamm.

guide_cards.alt: Zwei Frauen spazieren am Bootssteg des Montiggler Sees
guide_cards.title: Montiggler Seen
guide_cards.desc: Großer und Kleiner Montiggler See mitten im Montiggler Wald, freier Seezugang an zahlreichen Stellen, dazu eine Liegewiese mit Schwimmbad-Charakter.

guide_cards.alt: MMM Firmian, Schloss Sigmundskron
guide_cards.title: MMM Firmian: Messner Mountain Museum
guide_cards.desc: Reinhold Messners Hauptmuseum in der über 1.000 Jahre alten Burg Sigmundskron, Bergsteigergeschichte, Kunst und ein fantastischer Blick auf Bozen und das Etschtal.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: 15 € Erw. · 6 € Kinder (6–18) · Familie 34 € Mitte März–Anfang Nov., Do Ruhetag

guide_cards.alt: Mendelbahn zur Mendel-Wanderung
guide_cards.title: Mendel-Standseilbahn & Wanderung
guide_cards.desc: Mit der historischen, steilsten Standseilbahn Europas hinauf auf die Mendel (1.363 m), von dort Wanderung über Enzianhütte und Malga Romeno zur Überetscher Hütte mit Blick bis zu den Dolomiten.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: ca. 20–25 Fahrmin. nach St. Anton/Kaltern ca. 4:20 Std. Wanderzeit
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: Standseilbahn ca. 8–10 € · Wanderung kostenlos ca. 15,2 km · +539 Hm/−531 Hm

guide_cards.alt: Roen, höchster Gipfel des Mendelkamms
guide_cards.title: Roen, Gipfeltour über dem Kalterer See
guide_cards.desc: Von der Mendelpasshöhe oder der Bergstation der Kabinenbahn hinauf auf den höchsten Gipfel des Mendelkamms (2.116 m), Rundblick auf Dolomiten, Adamello, Ortler und bis zu den Drei­tausendern des Alpenhauptkamms.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: kostenlos · Kabinenbahn ca. 10 € ca. 12 km · ca. 700 Hm

guide_cards.alt: Ruine Leuchtenburg über dem Kalterer See
guide_cards.place: Start: Ostufer Kalterer See, bei Klughammer
guide_cards.title: Leuchtenburg, Ruine über dem Kalterer See
guide_cards.desc: Kurzer, leichter Aufstieg vom Kalterer See zur eindrucksvoll gelegenen Burgruine Leuchtenburg (um 1200 erbaut, 576 m) mit Fresken aus dem 15. Jh. und weitem Blick über das Etschtal. Wer mag, geht weiter zu den Rosszähnen und den Warmlöchern.

guide_cards.alt: Gleifkirche bei Eppan
guide_cards.title: Eppan Berg, Gleifkirche & Kreuzstein
guide_cards.desc: Über den Kreuzweg mit neun Kapellen hinauf zur barocken Gleifkirche (1720, 555 m) mit Blick auf Bozen, Schlern und Latemar, weiter zum Aussichtspunkt Kreuzstein mit Wettterkreuz und urigem Landgasthof.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: ca. 5–10 Fahrmin. oder zu Fuß ab St. Michael ca. 1,5 Std.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: kostenlos ca. 5 km · leicht

guide_cards.alt: Mitterbergerrunde bei Eppan
guide_cards.title: Mitterbergerrunde, Eppan · Auer · Bozen
guide_cards.desc: Rundtour auf durchgehend asphaltierten Radwegen: von Eppan über die alte Bahntrasse nach Kaltern, hinunter zum Kalterer See und nach Auer, dann auf dem Etschtal-Radweg über Sigmundskron nach Bozen und über die alte Bahntrasse zurück nach Eppan.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: kostenlos ca. 45 km · flach, asphaltiert

guide_cards.alt: Weinberge der Kellerei St. Pauls
guide_cards.title: Kellerei St. Pauls, Weinführung & Verkostung
guide_cards.desc: Spaziergang durch das Paulsnerfeld mit Einblick in die Geschichte der 1907 gegründeten Genossenschaft und ihre Weinberge zwischen 300 und 700 m Höhe, gefolgt von einer geführten Verkostung in der Vinothek, nur wenige Gehminuten vom Hotel entfernt.

guide_cards.alt: Sektbunker der Kellerei St. Pauls
guide_cards.title: Kellerei St. Pauls „Preclarus", Führung durch den Bunker
guide_cards.desc: Weinspaziergang durch das Paulsnerfeld zum historischen Bunker aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg (1937/38 erbaut). Seit 1979 reift hier bei konstant 12–14°C der Praeclarus-Sekt zwischen meterdicken Mauern, Rüttelpulten und Kammern. Inklusive Verkostung.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: ca. 16 € p.P. (WinePass −50 %) 🍾 Dienstags 15:30 Uhr · Anmeldung nötig

guide_cards.alt: Riva del Garda am Gardasee
guide_cards.title: Tagesausflug an den Gardasee
guide_cards.desc: Über den Mendelpass oder das Etschtal in gut 1,5–2 Std. an den Nordrand des Gardasees, Seepromenade und Altstadt in Riva del Garda, Windsurfer in Torbole und die Bergbahn auf den Monte Baldo mit Panoramablick.

guide_cards.alt: Marktstand mit frischem Gemüse am Bauernmarkt St. Michael/Eppan
guide_cards.title: Bauernmarkt St. Michael/Eppan
guide_cards.desc: Ganzjährig jeden Dienstagvormittag verkaufen Südtiroler Bauern ihr eigenes Obst, Gemüse, Käse und weitere Hofprodukte auf dem Rathausplatz mitten im Dorf.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: kostenloser Eintritt ganzjährig, dienstagvormittags

guide_cards.alt: Verkostung in der Brennerei St. Urban in Girlan, Eppan
guide_cards.title: Brennerei St. Urban, Verkostung
guide_cards.desc: Edelbrände und feine Spirituosen aus vollreifem, selbst angebautem Obst, seit 2008 von Erwin Leimgruber in Girlan gebrannt. Verkostungen im Gewölbekeller auf Anfrage.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: Verkostung auf Anfrage Anmeldung erforderlich

guide_cards.alt: Wanderweg zu den Eislöchern bei Eppan
guide_cards.title: Eislöcher-Wanderung
guide_cards.desc: Naturphänomen am Fuß des Gandbergs: Aus einem Bergsturz aus Porphyrgestein strömt kühle Luft und hält die Senke auch im Hochsommer spürbar kalt. Leichter Rundweg zwischen Eppan und Kaltern.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: kostenlos, frei zugänglich ca. 4 km · leicht

guide_cards.alt: Bogenschütze am Bogenparcours bei Burg Hocheppan
guide_cards.title: Bogenparcours Burg Hocheppan
guide_cards.desc: Mittelalterlicher 3D-Parcours mit 28 Tierfiguren im Wald unterhalb der Burg, geeignet für Anfänger und Kinder ab 6 Jahren. Die komplette Runde dauert rund drei Stunden, eine kurze Runde etwa die Hälfte.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: 15 € eig. Ausrüstung · 25 € Leihausrüstung täglich außer Mi, April–Anfang Nov.

guide_cards.alt: Sekt-Verkostung in der Sektmanufaktur Winkler in Girlan
guide_cards.title: Sektmanufaktur Winkler, Verkostung
guide_cards.desc: Familienbetrieb in Girlan mit Einblick in die traditionelle Flaschengärung und Verkostung des hauseigenen Sekts „Lamm Nr. 12" samt kleiner Häppchen, ganz persönlich von der Familie Winkler.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: Verkostung auf Anfrage Terminvereinbarung nötig

guide_cards.alt: Bunte Schirme über der Dorfgasse beim Langen Mittwoch in St. Michael/Eppan
guide_cards.title: Langer Mittwoch in St. Michael
guide_cards.desc: An Sommerabenden im Juli und August verwandeln bunte, beleuchtete Schirme über den Gassen St. Michaels die Geschäftsstraße in eine Flaniermeile mit Live-Musik, Straßenkunst und langen Öffnungszeiten.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: kostenloser Eintritt mittwochs, Juli & August

guide_cards.alt: Teller mit hausgemachten Schlutzkrapfen (Schlutzer) beim Südtiroler Kochkurs
guide_cards.title: Schlutzer-Kurs
guide_cards.desc: Gemeinsam mit einer Eppaner Bäuerin auf dem Bauernmarkt einkaufen, dann Schritt für Schritt die halbmondförmigen Schlutzkrapfen (Schlutzer) mit Spinat-Ricotta-Füllung von Hand formen und in Butter geschwenkt genießen – eine der beliebtesten Almspezialitäten Südtirols. Verkostet mit einem Glas Eppaner Wein. Zutaten und Material inklusive.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: Preis auf Anfrage dienstags, saisonal · Anmeldung nötig

guide_cards.alt: Mountainbiker im Montiggler Wald
guide_cards.title: MTB-Tour durch den Montiggler Wald
guide_cards.desc: Von Kaltern führt Weg Nr. 4 durchs Lavasontal hinauf in den Montiggler Wald, vorbei am Großen und Kleinen Montiggler See, weiter über Schreckbichl in die Weinlandschaft von Girlan und zurück über St. Michael auf dem Überetscher Radweg nach Kaltern.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: ca. 15 Fahrmin. zum Start ca. 2 Std. (mit Pausen)
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: kostenlos ca. 11,3 km · leicht, ca. 310 Hm

de.cta_text: Fragt uns nach Tipps, Leihrädern und Routenvorschlägen. Wir kennen die Umgebung wie unseren Garten.

it.meta_description: Escursioni, bici, golf, cultura e dintorni vicino all'Hotel Weinberg a St. Paolo/Appiano, sentiero delle Tre Castella, Golfclub Appiano, Lago di Caldaro, Laghi di Monticolo e altro.
it.hero_text: Castelli, laghi e vigneti proprio davanti alla porta, nel cuore di una delle più belle regioni vacanziere dell'Alto Adige.
it.story_lede: Continuate a scorrere tra escursioni, bici, golf, cultura e dintorni, alla fine troverete tutti i consigli come schede, filtrabili per tipo e tempo necessario.

chapters.heading: Castelli, boschi e valli in fiore
chapters.lede: Dal sentiero delle Tre Castella tra Hocheppan, Boymont e Korb fino alla fiorita Frühlingstal tra i Laghi di Monticolo e il Lago di Caldaro, i sentieri iniziano proprio davanti a casa.
chapters.body: Anche la storica funicolare della Mendola con la vetta del Roen, la rovina di Leuchtenburg sopra il Lago di Caldaro e la tranquilla via crucis verso la Chiesa di Gleif con il belvedere Kreuzstein sono raggiungibili in 10-25 minuti d'auto.

tips.alt: Bosco di Monticolo con i laghi
tips.title: Bosco di Monticolo con i laghi

chapters.heading: Due ruote tra i vigneti
chapters.lede: La pista ciclabile sull'ex sedime ferroviario Bolzano–Appiano–Caldaro passa proprio accanto ai vigneti dell'hotel, piatta, adatta alle famiglie e con ampia vista sulle Dolomiti.
chapters.body: Chi vuole proseguire segue la pista ciclabile della Val d'Adige fino a Merano, oppure percorre l'anello del Mitterberg da Appiano attraverso il Lago di Caldaro e Ora fino a Bolzano, quasi sempre pianeggiante, tra frutteti e antichi masi.

tips.alt: Vino & bici al Lago di Caldaro
tips.title: Vino & bici al Lago di Caldaro

chapters.heading: Tee-off con vista sul castello
chapters.lede: Il Golfclub Appiano "Blue Monster" si trova a pochi minuti d'auto, un campo da 9 buche con laghi e vista sulle montagne, accanto il centro di allenamento Schloss Freudenstein con campo pratica, driving range e putting green.
chapters.body: Per round più lunghi, l'impianto da 9 buche di Lana e il campo da 18 buche Dolomiti sulla Mendola sono raggiungibili in circa 30-45 minuti d'auto.

chapters.heading: Tre castelli, mille anni di storia
chapters.lede: Il castello di Hocheppan con la sua cappella romanica, il castello di Boymont e il castello di Korb segnano la silhouette sopra i vigneti.
chapters.body: Chi prosegue trova nel castello di Sigmundskron il Messner Mountain Museum Firmian: storia dell'alpinismo con vista panoramica su Bolzano. E proprio accanto, a St. Paolo, la Cantina di St. Paolo apre le sue porte: per una visita guidata tra i vigneti del Paulsnerfeld o per il tour "Preclarus" nel bunker spumantistico della Seconda Guerra Mondiale.

chapters.heading: Laghi in cui rilassarsi
chapters.lede: I Laghi di Monticolo con accesso libero e il Lago di Caldaro con le sue spiagge si trovano entrambi a circa 15-20 minuti d'auto, ideali per un pomeriggio in riva all'acqua.
chapters.body: Chi vuole dedicare un'intera giornata può passare per il Passo della Mendola o per la Val d'Adige fino al Lago di Garda, Riva del Garda e Torbole con lungolago, windsurfisti e la funivia sul Monte Baldo.

guide_cards.alt: Castello di Korb, Sentiero delle Tre Castella
guide_cards.title: Sentiero delle Tre Castella
guide_cards.desc: Piacevole tour per famiglie lungo il sentiero dei castelli n. 9 fino al castello di Hocheppan con la cappella romanica, proseguendo verso il castello di Boymont e ritorno passando per il castello di Korb.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 10 min in auto alla partenza circa 2,5–3 ore
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: gratuito · cappella del castello circa 3 € circa 8 km · circa 250 m di dislivello
guide_cards.hours: Percorribile tutto l'anno · facile, adatto alle famiglie

guide_cards.alt: Castello di Hocheppan con la cappella
guide_cards.title: Castello di Hocheppan & cappella
guide_cards.desc: Il castello meglio conservato dell'Alto Adige, con la cappella romanica e i suoi affreschi del XII secolo, la cappella è accessibile solo con una visita guidata storico-artistica, e sotto, nella locanda del castello, si gusta cucina altoatesina con vista panoramica.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 10 min in auto + breve tratto a piedi visita guidata circa 30 min, visita circa 1–1,5 ore
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: cappella/visita guidata circa 3 € visite guidate 11:00–16:30, secondo la stagione gio–lun
guide_cards.hours: Stagione dal 28 marzo a novembre · locanda tutti i giorni 10–18, mercoledì chiuso

guide_cards.alt: Castello di Boymont vicino ad Appiano
guide_cards.title: Castello di Boymont
guide_cards.desc: Rovina di castello restaurata nel 1977, con mura ben conservate e un suggestivo cortile interno, oggi con una stazione di ristoro, ideale per una sosta all'ombra delle antiche mura a metà del sentiero dei castelli.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 10 min in auto circa 45 min di visita
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: ingresso alla rovina su richiesta Pasqua–novembre, mar–dom 10–18
guide_cards.hours: Stazione di ristoro nel cortile del castello

guide_cards.alt: Frühlingstal vicino ad Appiano
guide_cards.title: Frühlingstal fino al Lago di Caldaro
guide_cards.desc: Facile escursione lungo il rio Angelbach attraverso boschi di latifoglie e misti ricchi di fioriture, tra il Lago di Monticolo e il Lago di Caldaro, a inizio primavera un mare di fiori di bucaneve primaverile.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 15–18 min in auto alla partenza circa 2,5 ore
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: gratuito circa 10 km · pianeggiante
guide_cards.hours: Facile, adatto alle famiglie · periodo migliore: feb.–apr.

guide_cards.alt: Escursionisti si riposano sulla riva del Lago di Monticolo in autunno
guide_cards.place: Partenza: Schreckbichl o Lago Grande di Monticolo
guide_cards.title: Bosco di Monticolo con i laghi
guide_cards.desc: Sentieri ombreggiati nel bosco di Monticolo, passando per il Lago Grande e il Lago Piccolo di Monticolo, con una breve deviazione al belvedere Wilder-Mann-Bühel, tranquillo, pianeggiante e apprezzata meta ricreativa tutto l'anno.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 15–20 min in auto alla partenza circa 2–2,5 ore
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: gratuito circa 6–8 km · pianeggiante
guide_cards.hours: Percorribile tutto l'anno · facile, adatto alle famiglie

guide_cards.alt: Pista ciclabile dell'Oltradige, Appiano
guide_cards.title: Vino & bici al Lago di Caldaro
guide_cards.desc: Pista ciclabile quasi pianeggiante su un ex tracciato ferroviario, passa direttamente accanto ai vigneti dell'hotel fino al Lago di Caldaro, ideale anche con i bambini.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: direttamente dall'hotel circa 1,5 ore di sola andata
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: gratuito · noleggio e-bike da circa 25 €/giorno circa 18 km · pianeggiante

guide_cards.alt: Pista ciclabile della Val d'Adige verso Merano
guide_cards.title: Pista ciclabile della Val d'Adige verso Merano
guide_cards.desc: Tour rilassante, quasi sempre pianeggiante, lungo il fiume, passando per frutteti, antichi masi e il castello di Sigmundskron fino a Merano.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 10 min in auto alla pista ciclabile della Val d'Adige circa 3–4 ore di sola andata
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: gratuito · ritorno possibile in treno circa 45 km · pianeggiante

guide_cards.alt: Centro di allenamento Schloss Freudenstein
guide_cards.title: Centro di allenamento Schloss Freudenstein
guide_cards.desc: Campo pratica di 4 buche, driving range di 240 m con 16 postazioni e un ampio putting green, circondato da vigneti, con bar e simulatore di golf per le giornate di brutto tempo.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 10 min in auto a partire da circa 1 ora
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: green fee circa 20 € · giornaliero range circa 15 € ⛳ 4 buche + campo pratica

guide_cards.alt: Golfclub Appiano Blue Monster
guide_cards.title: Golfclub Appiano "Blue Monster"
guide_cards.desc: Campo da 9 buche (Par 35) dell'architetto Thomas C. Himmel, aperto nel 2015, chiamato così per i numerosi ostacoli d'acqua, circondato da meleti e con classificazione 4 stelle superior.
guide_cards.hours: Aperto stagionalmente · scuola di golf & simulatore in loco

guide_cards.alt: Golfclub Lana Gutshof Brandis
guide_cards.title: Golfclub Lana "Gutshof Brandis"
guide_cards.desc: Impianto da 9 buche (Par 35, 2.793 m) sotto la rovina del castello di Brandis vicino a Merano, disegnato dall'architetto di campi inglese Michael Pinner, posizione pittoresca con vista sul Gruppo di Tessa.

guide_cards.alt: Golfclub Dolomiti Sarnonico sulla Mendola
guide_cards.title: Golfclub Dolomiti (Sarnonico/Mendola)
guide_cards.desc: Campo da 18 buche a 900 m di altitudine, aperto nel 1991, uno degli impianti più impegnativi delle Alpi, circondato da boschi, frutteti e villaggi di montagna oltre il Passo della Mendola.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: green fee su richiesta ⛳ 18 buche + 4 buche pratica
guide_cards.hours: Aperto stagionalmente · scuola di golf in loco

guide_cards.alt: Lago di Caldaro
guide_cards.title: Lago di Caldaro
guide_cards.desc: Uno dei laghi balneabili più caldi delle Alpi, circondato da vigneti, quattro stabilimenti balneari con prato solarium, pontile e vista sul Gruppo della Mendola.

guide_cards.alt: Due donne passeggiano sul pontile del Lago di Monticolo
guide_cards.title: Laghi di Monticolo
guide_cards.desc: Lago Grande e Lago Piccolo di Monticolo nel cuore del bosco di Monticolo, accesso libero al lago in numerosi punti, oltre a un prato solarium con carattere di piscina naturale.

guide_cards.alt: MMM Firmian, castello di Sigmundskron
guide_cards.place: Castello di Sigmundskron, vicino a Bolzano
guide_cards.title: MMM Firmian: Messner Mountain Museum
guide_cards.desc: Il museo principale di Reinhold Messner nel castello di Sigmundskron, vecchio di oltre 1.000 anni, storia dell'alpinismo, arte e una vista fantastica su Bolzano e la Val d'Adige.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 20–25 min in auto circa 2 ore incl. trasferimento
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: 15 € adulti · 6 € bambini (6–18) · famiglia 34 € metà marzo–inizio nov., giovedì chiuso

guide_cards.alt: Funicolare della Mendola per l'escursione
guide_cards.title: Funicolare della Mendola & escursione
guide_cards.desc: Con la storica funicolare più ripida d'Europa fino alla Mendola (1.363 m), da lì escursione passando per il rifugio Enzian e Malga Romeno fino al rifugio Überetscher, con vista fino alle Dolomiti.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 20–25 min in auto fino a St. Antonio/Caldaro circa 4:20 ore di cammino
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: funicolare circa 8–10 € · escursione gratuita circa 15,2 km · +539 m/−531 m di dislivello
guide_cards.hours: Funicolare della Mendola aperta tutto l'anno, salvo revisione stagionale

guide_cards.alt: Roen, la vetta più alta del Gruppo della Mendola
guide_cards.place: Partenza: Passo della Mendola / stazione a monte della cabinovia
guide_cards.title: Roen, tour alla vetta sopra il Lago di Caldaro
guide_cards.desc: Dal Passo della Mendola o dalla stazione a monte della cabinovia fino alla vetta più alta del Gruppo della Mendola (2.116 m), vista a 360° su Dolomiti, Adamello, Ortles e fino ai tremila del crinale alpino principale.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 25–30 min in auto alla partenza circa 4–5 ore
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: gratuito · cabinovia circa 10 € circa 12 km · circa 700 m di dislivello
guide_cards.hours: Maggio–ottobre · impegnativo dal punto di vista fisico

guide_cards.alt: Rovina di Leuchtenburg sopra il Lago di Caldaro
guide_cards.place: Partenza: sponda est del Lago di Caldaro, presso Klughammer
guide_cards.title: Leuchtenburg, rovina sopra il Lago di Caldaro
guide_cards.desc: Breve e facile salita dal Lago di Caldaro fino alla suggestiva rovina di Leuchtenburg (costruita intorno al 1200, 576 m) con affreschi del XV secolo e ampia vista sulla Val d'Adige. Chi vuole può proseguire verso i Rosszähne e i Warmlöcher.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 15–18 min in auto alla partenza circa 1 ora
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: gratuito circa 3 km · circa 200 m di dislivello
guide_cards.hours: Percorribile tutto l'anno · facile, adatto alle famiglie

guide_cards.alt: Chiesa di Gleif vicino ad Appiano
guide_cards.title: Monte di Appiano, Chiesa di Gleif & Kreuzstein
guide_cards.desc: Attraverso la via crucis con nove cappelle fino alla barocca Chiesa di Gleif (1720, 555 m) con vista su Bolzano, Sciliar e Latemar, proseguendo fino al belvedere Kreuzstein con croce panoramica e una rustica locanda.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 5–10 min in auto o a piedi da San Michele circa 1,5 ore
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: gratuito circa 5 km · facile
guide_cards.hours: Percorribile tutto l'anno · facile, adatto alle famiglie

guide_cards.alt: Anello del Mitterberg vicino ad Appiano
guide_cards.title: Anello del Mitterberg, Appiano · Ora · Bolzano
guide_cards.desc: Tour ad anello su piste ciclabili interamente asfaltate: da Appiano lungo l'antico tracciato ferroviario fino a Caldaro, scendendo al Lago di Caldaro e proseguendo per Ora, poi sulla pista ciclabile della Val d'Adige attraverso Sigmundskron fino a Bolzano e di nuovo per l'antico tracciato ferroviario fino ad Appiano.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: direttamente dall'hotel circa 3–4 ore
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: gratuito circa 45 km · pianeggiante, asfaltato

guide_cards.alt: Vigneti della Cantina di St. Paolo
guide_cards.place: Cantina di St. Paolo, St. Paolo/Appiano
guide_cards.title: Cantina di St. Paolo, visita guidata & degustazione
guide_cards.desc: Passeggiata attraverso il Paulsnerfeld con uno sguardo alla storia della cooperativa fondata nel 1907 e ai suoi vigneti tra 300 e 700 m di altitudine, seguita da una degustazione guidata in enoteca, a pochi minuti a piedi dall'hotel.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 5 min in auto o a piedi circa 1,5–2 ore

guide_cards.alt: Bunker spumantistico della Cantina di St. Paolo
guide_cards.place: Cantina di St. Paolo, St. Paolo/Appiano
guide_cards.title: Cantina di St. Paolo "Preclarus", visita al bunker
guide_cards.desc: Passeggiata tra i vigneti del Paulsnerfeld fino allo storico bunker della Seconda Guerra Mondiale (costruito nel 1937/38). Dal 1979 qui matura a 12–14°C costanti lo spumante Preclarus, tra mura spesse un metro, tavoli di remuage e camere. Degustazione inclusa.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 5 min in auto o a piedi circa 2–2,5 ore
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: circa 16 € a persona (WinePass −50%) 🍾 martedì ore 15:30 · prenotazione necessaria

guide_cards.alt: Riva del Garda sul Lago di Garda
guide_cards.title: Gita di un giorno al Lago di Garda
guide_cards.desc: Attraverso il Passo della Mendola o la Val d'Adige in circa 1,5–2 ore fino alla sponda nord del Lago di Garda, lungolago e centro storico a Riva del Garda, windsurfisti a Torbole e la funivia sul Monte Baldo con vista panoramica.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 1,5–2 ore di viaggio giornata intera

guide_cards.alt: Bancarella con verdura fresca al mercato contadino di San Michele/Appiano
guide_cards.title: Mercato contadino di San Michele/Appiano
guide_cards.desc: Tutto l'anno, ogni martedì mattina, i contadini altoatesini vendono frutta, verdura, formaggi e altri prodotti dei propri masi in piazza Municipio, nel cuore del paese.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: ingresso gratuito tutto l'anno, il martedì mattina

guide_cards.alt: Degustazione alla Distilleria St. Urban a Cornaiano, Appiano
guide_cards.title: Distilleria St. Urban, degustazione
guide_cards.desc: Distillati pregiati e acqueviti da frutta matura di produzione propria, distillati dal 2008 da Erwin Leimgruber a Cornaiano. Degustazioni nella cantina a volta su richiesta.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: degustazione su richiesta prenotazione necessaria

guide_cards.alt: Sentiero verso le buche di ghiaccio (Eislöcher) vicino ad Appiano
guide_cards.title: Escursione alle buche di ghiaccio
guide_cards.desc: Fenomeno naturale ai piedi del Gandberg: da una frana di porfido fuoriesce aria fredda che mantiene la conca gelida anche in piena estate. Facile anello tra Appiano e Caldaro.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 10 min. d'auto alla partenza circa 1,5–2 ore
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: gratuito, libero accesso circa 4 km · facile

guide_cards.alt: Arciere al percorso d'arco presso il castello di Hocheppan
guide_cards.place: Sotteargine/Missiano, presso il Castello di Hocheppan
guide_cards.title: Percorso di tiro con l'arco, Castello di Hocheppan
guide_cards.desc: Percorso 3D in stile medievale con 28 sagome di animali nel bosco sotto il castello, adatto a principianti e bambini dai 6 anni. Il giro completo dura circa tre ore, quello breve circa la metà.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: 15 € attrezzatura propria · 25 € a noleggio tutti i giorni tranne mer., apr.–inizio nov.

guide_cards.alt: Degustazione di spumante alla Sektmanufaktur Winkler a Cornaiano
guide_cards.title: Sektmanufaktur Winkler, degustazione
guide_cards.desc: Azienda familiare a Cornaiano che apre le porte alla rifermentazione tradizionale in bottiglia e fa degustare il proprio spumante "Lamm Nr. 12" con piccoli assaggi, accolti personalmente dalla famiglia Winkler.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: degustazione su richiesta prenotazione necessaria

guide_cards.alt: Ombrelli colorati sopra i vicoli durante il Langer Mittwoch a San Michele/Appiano
guide_cards.title: Langer Mittwoch a San Michele
guide_cards.desc: Nelle sere d'estate di luglio e agosto, ombrelli colorati e illuminati sopra i vicoli trasformano la via principale di San Michele in un salotto a cielo aperto con musica dal vivo, arte di strada e negozi aperti fino a tardi.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: ingresso gratuito il mercoledì, luglio e agosto

guide_cards.alt: Piatto di schlutzkrapfen (Schlutzer) fatti in casa durante il corso di cucina altoatesina
guide_cards.place: Via Stazione 7 (Associazione Turistica Appiano), San Michele/Appiano
guide_cards.title: Corso di Schlutzkrapfen
guide_cards.desc: Insieme a una contadina di Appiano si fa la spesa al mercato contadino, poi passo dopo passo si formano a mano gli schlutzkrapfen (Schlutzer), i tipici ravioli a mezzaluna con ripieno di spinaci e ricotta, saltati nel burro – una delle specialità più amate dei masi altoatesini. Degustazione con un bicchiere di vino di Appiano. Ingredienti e materiale inclusi.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: prezzo su richiesta il martedì, stagionale · prenotazione necessaria

guide_cards.alt: Mountain bike nel Bosco di Monticolo
guide_cards.place: Partenza: Caldaro (locomotiva a vapore in via Cantine)
guide_cards.title: Giro in MTB nel Bosco di Monticolo
guide_cards.desc: Da Caldaro il sentiero n. 4 sale attraverso la Val di Lavason nel Bosco di Monticolo, passando per il Lago Grande e il Lago Piccolo di Monticolo, prosegue verso Schreckbichl fino al paesaggio vitato di Girlano e ritorna via San Michele lungo la pista ciclabile dell'Oltradige fino a Caldaro.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: circa 15 min in auto alla partenza circa 2 ore (con soste)
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: gratuito circa 11,3 km · facile, circa 310 m di dislivello

it.cta_heading: Vacanza attiva direttamente sulla Strada del Vino
it.cta_text: Chiedeteci consigli, biciclette a noleggio e proposte di percorsi. Conosciamo i dintorni come il nostro giardino.

en.meta_description: Hiking, biking, golf, culture and surroundings near Hotel Weinberg in St. Pauls/Eppan, the Three Castles trail, Golf Club Eppan, Lake Caldaro, Montiggl Lakes and more.
en.hero_heading:
Hiking, biking, relaxing:
right on the doorstep
en.hero_text: Castles, lakes and vineyards right on your doorstep, at the heart of one of South Tyrol's most beautiful holiday regions.
en.story_lede: Scroll on through hiking, biking, golf, culture and the surrounding area, at the end you'll find every tip as a filterable card, sorted by type and time needed.

chapters.heading: Castles, forests and blossoming valleys
chapters.lede: From the Three Castles trail linking Hocheppan, Boymont and Korb to the blossoming Frühlingstal between the Montiggl Lakes and Lake Caldaro, the trails start right at the door.
chapters.body: The historic Mendel funicular with its Mount Roen summit, the Leuchtenburg ruin above Lake Caldaro, and the quiet Way of the Cross up to the Gleif church with its Kreuzstein lookout are all within a 10-25 minute drive.

chapters.heading: Two wheels through the vineyards
chapters.lede: The cycle path along the former Bolzano–Eppan–Kaltern railway line runs right past the hotel's own vineyards, flat, family-friendly, with sweeping views of the Dolomites.
chapters.body: Those wanting to go further can follow the Adige Valley cycle path all the way to Merano, or ride the Mitterberg loop from Eppan via Lake Caldaro and Auer to Bolzano, nearly all flat, through orchards and old farmsteads.

tips.alt: Adige Valley cycle path to Merano
tips.title: Adige Valley cycle path to Merano

chapters.bg_alt: Golf Club Eppan Blue Monster from above
chapters.heading: Tee off with a view of the castle
chapters.lede: Golf Club Eppan "Blue Monster" is just a few minutes' drive away, a 9-hole course with water hazards and mountain views, next to the Schloss Freudenstein training centre with its practice course, driving range and putting green.
chapters.body: For longer rounds, the 9-hole course in Lana and the 18-hole Golf Club Dolomiti on Mendel Pass are within about a 30-45 minute drive.

chapters.heading: Three castles, a thousand years of history
chapters.lede: Hocheppan Castle with its Romanesque chapel, Boymont Castle and Korb Castle line the ridge above the vineyards.
chapters.body: Further afield, Sigmundskron Castle houses the Messner Mountain Museum Firmian: the history of mountaineering with a panoramic view over Bolzano. And right next door in St. Pauls, the St. Pauls winery opens its doors: for a guided walk through the Paulsnerfeld vineyards or the "Preclarus" tour through its WWII sparkling-wine bunker.

chapters.heading: Lakes to unwind by
chapters.lede: The freely accessible Montiggl Lakes and Lake Caldaro with its beach lidos are both about 15-20 minutes away by car, perfect for an afternoon by the water.
chapters.body: For a full day out, drive over Mendel Pass or through the Adige Valley to Lake Garda, Riva del Garda and Torbole with their lakeside promenades, windsurfers and the Monte Baldo cable car.

guide_cards.alt: Korb Castle, Three Castles Hike
guide_cards.title: Three Castles Hike
guide_cards.desc: A pleasant family-friendly walk along castle trail no. 9 to Hocheppan Castle with its Romanesque chapel, continuing on to Boymont Castle and back past Korb Castle.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 10 min drive to start approx. 2.5–3 hrs
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: free · castle chapel approx. €3 approx. 8 km · approx. 250 m elevation gain

guide_cards.alt: Hocheppan Castle with its chapel
guide_cards.title: Hocheppan Castle & Chapel
guide_cards.desc: South Tyrol's best-preserved castle, with a Romanesque chapel and 12th-century frescoes, the chapel is only accessible on a guided art-history tour, and below it the castle inn serves South Tyrolean cuisine with panoramic views.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 10 min drive + short walk tour approx. 30 min, visit approx. 1–1.5 hrs
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: chapel/tour approx. €3 guided tours 11:00–16:30, Thu–Mon depending on season
guide_cards.hours: Season late March–November · inn open daily 10–18, closed Wednesdays

guide_cards.alt: Boymont Castle near Eppan
guide_cards.title: Boymont Castle
guide_cards.desc: A castle ruin restored in 1977, with well-preserved walls and an atmospheric inner courtyard, today home to a refreshment stop, perfect for a shady break beneath the old walls halfway along the castle trail.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 10 min drive approx. 45 min visit
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: ruin entry by donation Easter–November, Tue–Sun 10–18
guide_cards.hours: Refreshment stop in the castle courtyard

guide_cards.alt: Frühlingstal near Eppan
guide_cards.title: Frühlingstal to Lake Caldaro
guide_cards.desc: An easy walk along the Angelbach stream through deciduous and mixed forest rich in wildflowers, between the Montiggl Lakes and Lake Caldaro, an early-spring sea of snowflake blossoms.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 15–18 min drive to start approx. 2.5 hrs

guide_cards.alt: Hikers resting on the shore of Lake Monticolo in autumn
guide_cards.place: Start: Schreckbichl or Great Montiggl Lake
guide_cards.title: Montiggl Forest with its Lakes
guide_cards.desc: Shaded trails through Montiggl forest, past the Great and Small Montiggl Lakes, with a short detour to the Wilder-Mann-Bühel viewpoint, quiet, flat and a popular year-round destination.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 15–20 min drive to start approx. 2–2.5 hrs

guide_cards.alt: Überetsch cycle path, Eppan
guide_cards.title: Wine & Biking at Lake Caldaro
guide_cards.desc: A nearly flat cycle path on a former railway line, running right past the hotel's own vineyards to Lake Caldaro, great for families too.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: directly from the hotel approx. 1.5 hrs one way
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: free · e-bike rental approx. €25/day approx. 18 km · flat

guide_cards.alt: Adige Valley cycle path to Merano
guide_cards.title: Adige Valley Cycle Path to Merano
guide_cards.desc: A relaxed, nearly flat tour along the river, past orchards, old farmsteads and Sigmundskron Castle all the way to Merano.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 10 min drive to the Adige Valley cycle path approx. 3–4 hrs one way
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: free · return possible by train approx. 45 km · flat

guide_cards.alt: Schloss Freudenstein training centre
guide_cards.title: Schloss Freudenstein Training Centre
guide_cards.desc: A 4-hole practice course, 240 m driving range with 16 bays and a large putting green, set among vineyards, with a bar and golf simulator for bad-weather days.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 10 min drive from approx. 1 hr
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: green fee approx. €20 · daily range pass approx. €15 ⛳ 4 holes + practice course

guide_cards.alt: Golf Club Eppan Blue Monster
guide_cards.title: Golf Club Eppan "Blue Monster"
guide_cards.desc: A 9-hole course (Par 35) by architect Thomas C. Himmel, opened in 2015, named for its many water hazards, surrounded by apple orchards and rated 4-star superior.
guide_cards.hours: Seasonal opening · golf school & simulator on site

guide_cards.alt: Golf Club Lana Gutshof Brandis
guide_cards.title: Golf Club Lana "Gutshof Brandis"
guide_cards.desc: A 9-hole course (Par 35, 2,793 m) below the Brandis Castle ruin near Merano, designed by English course architect Michael Pinner, a picturesque setting with views of the Texel Group.

guide_cards.alt: Golf Club Dolomiti Sarnonico on Mendel Pass
guide_cards.place: Sarnonico, Upper Val di Non (Mendel Pass)
guide_cards.title: Golf Club Dolomiti (Sarnonico/Mendel Pass)
guide_cards.desc: An 18-hole course at 900 m altitude, opened in 1991, one of the most challenging courses in the Alps, surrounded by forests, orchards and mountain villages beyond Mendel Pass.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: green fee on request ⛳ 18 holes + 4-hole practice course
guide_cards.hours: Seasonal opening · golf school on site

guide_cards.alt: Lake Caldaro
guide_cards.title: Lake Caldaro
guide_cards.desc: One of the warmest bathing lakes in the Alps, surrounded by vineyards, four lidos with sunbathing lawns, jetties and views of the Mendel range.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 15 min drive as long as you like

guide_cards.alt: Two women walking along the jetty at Lake Monticolo
guide_cards.title: Montiggl Lakes
guide_cards.desc: The Great and Small Montiggl Lakes deep in Montiggl forest, free lake access at many points, plus a sunbathing lawn with a natural-pool feel.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 15–20 min drive as long as you like

guide_cards.alt: MMM Firmian, Sigmundskron Castle
guide_cards.title: MMM Firmian: Messner Mountain Museum
guide_cards.desc: Reinhold Messner's flagship museum in Sigmundskron Castle, over 1,000 years old, mountaineering history, art and a fantastic view over Bolzano and the Adige Valley.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 20–25 min drive approx. 2 hrs incl. travel
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: €15 adults · €6 children (6–18) · family €34 mid-March–early Nov., closed Thursdays

guide_cards.alt: Mendel funicular for the hike
guide_cards.title: Mendel Funicular & Hike
guide_cards.desc: Ride Europe's steepest historic funicular up to Mendel Pass (1,363 m), then hike past the Enzian hut and Romeno alpine pasture to the Überetscher hut, with views reaching the Dolomites.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 20–25 min drive to St. Anton/Kaltern approx. 4:20 hrs of walking
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: funicular approx. €8–10 · hike free approx. 15.2 km · +539 m/−531 m elevation
guide_cards.hours: Mendel funicular open year-round, except seasonal maintenance

guide_cards.alt: Mount Roen, the highest peak of the Mendel range
guide_cards.place: Start: Mendel Pass / cable car mountain station
guide_cards.title: Mount Roen, Summit Hike above Lake Caldaro
guide_cards.desc: From Mendel Pass or the cable car's mountain station up to the highest peak of the Mendel range (2,116 m), a 360° view over the Dolomites, Adamello, Ortles and out to the peaks of the main Alpine ridge.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 25–30 min drive to start approx. 4–5 hrs
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: free · cable car approx. €10 approx. 12 km · approx. 700 m elevation gain

guide_cards.alt: Leuchtenburg ruin above Lake Caldaro
guide_cards.place: Start: eastern shore of Lake Caldaro, near Klughammer
guide_cards.title: Leuchtenburg, Ruin above Lake Caldaro
guide_cards.desc: A short, easy climb from Lake Caldaro up to the striking Leuchtenburg ruin (built around 1200, 576 m) with 15th-century frescoes and broad views over the Adige Valley. Those who want to continue can head on to the Rosszähne and Warmlöcher.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 15–18 min drive to start approx. 1 hr
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: free approx. 3 km · approx. 200 m elevation gain

guide_cards.alt: Gleif church near Eppan
guide_cards.title: Eppan Mountain, Gleif Church & Kreuzstein
guide_cards.desc: Follow the Way of the Cross with its nine chapels up to the baroque Gleif church (1720, 555 m) with views over Bolzano, the Sciliar and the Latemar, continue on to the Kreuzstein viewpoint with its summit cross and a rustic inn.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 5–10 min drive or walk from St. Michael approx. 1.5 hrs

guide_cards.alt: Mitterberg loop near Eppan
guide_cards.title: Mitterberg Loop, Eppan · Auer · Bolzano
guide_cards.desc: A fully paved loop tour: from Eppan along the old railway line to Kaltern, down to Lake Caldaro and on to Auer, then along the Adige Valley cycle path via Sigmundskron to Bolzano, and back along the old railway line to Eppan.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: directly from the hotel approx. 3–4 hrs
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: free approx. 45 km · flat, paved

guide_cards.alt: St. Pauls winery vineyards
guide_cards.title: St. Pauls Winery, Guided Tour & Tasting
guide_cards.desc: A walk through the Paulsnerfeld vineyards with a look at the history of the cooperative founded in 1907 and its vines between 300 and 700 m altitude, followed by a guided tasting in the wine shop, just a few minutes' walk from the hotel.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 5 min drive or walk approx. 1.5–2 hrs

guide_cards.alt: St. Pauls winery sparkling-wine bunker
guide_cards.title: St. Pauls Winery "Preclarus", Bunker Tour
guide_cards.desc: A walk through the Paulsnerfeld vineyards to a historic WWII bunker (built 1937/38). Since 1979 home to the Preclarus sparkling wine, ageing at a constant 12–14°C among metre-thick walls, riddling tables and chambers. Tasting included.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 5 min drive or walk approx. 2–2.5 hrs
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: approx. €16 per person (WinePass −50%) 🍾 Tuesdays 15:30 · booking required

guide_cards.alt: Riva del Garda on Lake Garda
guide_cards.title: Day Trip to Lake Garda
guide_cards.desc: Via Mendel Pass or the Adige Valley in about 1.5–2 hours to the northern shore of Lake Garda, lakeside promenade and old town in Riva del Garda, windsurfers in Torbole, and the Monte Baldo cable car with panoramic views.

guide_cards.alt: Market stall with fresh vegetables at the St. Michael/Eppan farmers' market
guide_cards.title: St. Michael/Eppan Farmers' Market
guide_cards.desc: Every Tuesday morning, year-round, South Tyrolean farmers sell their own fruit, vegetables, cheese and other farm products on the town hall square in the heart of the village.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: free entry year-round, Tuesday mornings

guide_cards.alt: Tasting at the St. Urban distillery in Girlan, Eppan
guide_cards.title: St. Urban Distillery, Tasting
guide_cards.desc: Fine brandies and spirits made from fully ripe, home-grown fruit, distilled since 2008 by Erwin Leimgruber in Girlan. Tastings in the vaulted cellar by request.

guide_cards.alt: Trail to the Eislöcher ice holes near Eppan
guide_cards.title: Eislöcher Ice Holes Hike
guide_cards.desc: A natural phenomenon at the foot of the Gandberg: cold air streams out of a porphyry rockslide, keeping the hollow noticeably cool even in midsummer. An easy loop between Eppan and Kaltern.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 10 min. drive to the start approx. 1.5–2 hours
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: free, open access approx. 4 km · easy

guide_cards.alt: Archer at the archery course near Hocheppan Castle
guide_cards.title: Hocheppan Castle Archery Course
guide_cards.desc: A medieval-style 3D course with 28 animal targets in the woods below the castle, suitable for beginners and children from age 6. The full round takes about three hours, the short round about half that.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: €15 own equipment · €25 rental equipment daily except Wed., April–early Nov.

guide_cards.alt: Sparkling wine tasting at Sektmanufaktur Winkler in Girlan
guide_cards.title: Sektmanufaktur Winkler, Tasting
guide_cards.desc: A family-run producer in Girlan offering insight into traditional bottle fermentation and a tasting of their own sparkling wine "Lamm Nr. 12" with light bites, hosted personally by the Winkler family.

guide_cards.alt: Colourful umbrellas over the lanes during Langer Mittwoch in St. Michael/Eppan
guide_cards.title: Langer Mittwoch in St. Michael
guide_cards.desc: On summer evenings in July and August, colourful illuminated umbrellas over the lanes turn St. Michael's high street into an open-air promenade with live music, street art and late shop openings.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: free entry Wednesdays, July & August

guide_cards.alt: Plate of homemade Schlutzkrapfen (Schlutzer) at the South Tyrolean cooking class
guide_cards.title: Schlutzkrapfen Cooking Class
guide_cards.desc: Shop for ingredients at the farmers' market together with a local farmer, then shape traditional Schlutzkrapfen (Schlutzer) by hand step by step — half-moon dumplings filled with spinach and ricotta, tossed in butter, one of South Tyrol's best-loved mountain-hut specialities. Tasted with a glass of Eppan wine. Ingredients and materials included.
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: price on request Tuesdays, seasonal · booking required

guide_cards.alt: Mountain bikers in Monticolo Forest
guide_cards.title: MTB Tour through Monticolo Forest
guide_cards.desc: From Kaltern, trail no. 4 climbs through the Lavason valley into Monticolo Forest, passing the Great and Small Lake of Monticolo, continuing via Schreckbichl into the vineyard landscape of Girlan and back via St. Michael along the Überetsch cycle path to Kaltern.
guide_cards.meta_row_1_html: approx. 15 min drive to start approx. 2 hrs (with breaks)
guide_cards.meta_row_2_html: free approx. 11.3 km · easy, approx. 310 m elevation gain

en.cta_heading: An active holiday, right on the Wine Route
en.cta_text: Ask us for tips, bike rentals and route suggestions. We know the surrounding area like our own garden.
